user.title: Echo Experience
user.description: Load device profiles from echo_experience.json in the Home Assistant configuration folder. Each Echo has its own satellite, speaker and dashboard view.

error.invalid_profiles: Check echo_experience.json: profiles must have unique satellites, device IDs and paths, with a music player and weather entity.

data_description.manage_dashboard: When on, the integration keeps the echo-home dashboard in sync with the profiles. Turn off to keep a hand-edited dashboard.

legacy_stop_automation.title: Disable the old voice stop automation
legacy_stop_automation.description: Echo Experience now handles “stop” and the music stop phrases itself, but the automation {entity_id} (id 1757961047860) is still enabled. Two handlers would answer the same sentence, so the built-in route stays off. Disable or delete that automation, then reload Echo Experience (Settings → Devices & services → Echo Experience → ⋮ → Reload). Do not re-enable the automation later without reloading Echo Experience first.

route_conflict.title: Voice stop route not registered
route_conflict.description: A voice device belongs to more than one Echo profile, so stop requests could not be routed safely: {detail}. Fix echo_experience.json and reload Echo Experience.

dashboard_hand_edited.title: Echo Home dashboard left unchanged
dashboard_hand_edited.description: The /{url} dashboard differs from the last configuration Echo Experience generated, so it was not overwritten and a manual edit is assumed. To hand it back: Settings → Dashboards → open it → Edit → Raw configuration editor → replace the content with the generated configuration (see the README) or delete and recreate the dashboard, then reload Echo Experience. To keep your version, turn off “Manage the Echo Home dashboard” in the integration options.

dashboard_yaml.title: Echo Home dashboard is not in storage mode
dashboard_yaml.description: A dashboard or panel already exists at {url} outside Lovelace storage. Echo Experience cannot manage it; remove it or change the integration options.

dashboard_write_failed.title: Echo Home dashboard could not be saved
dashboard_write_failed.description: Saving the {url} dashboard failed; see the Home Assistant log. The previous configuration was kept.

resources_yaml.title: Remove the old Echo Experience card resource
resources_yaml.description: Lovelace resources are configured in YAML. Remove the entry for {legacy} so only the integration-served card loads.

dashboard_missing.title: Create the Echo Home dashboard
dashboard_missing.description: No storage dashboard exists at /{url}. Home Assistant only lets its own UI create dashboards, so add one: Settings → Dashboards → Add dashboard → “New dashboard from scratch”, title “Echo Home”, URL “{url}”, show in sidebar. Leave it empty, then reload Echo Experience: an empty dashboard is adopted and filled with the Echo views.

dashboard_read_failed.title: Echo Home dashboard could not be read
dashboard_read_failed.description: Reading the /{url} dashboard failed, so Echo Experience did not touch it; see the Home Assistant log. Nothing was written and no backup was needed.

setup_failed_frontend.title: Echo Experience card not registered
setup_failed_frontend.description: Registering the card resource failed: {error}. Dashboards may show a missing “echo-experience-card”. Fix the cause (see the log), then reload Echo Experience.

setup_failed_dashboard.title: Echo Home dashboard not managed
setup_failed_dashboard.description: Managing the Echo Home dashboard failed: {error}. The dashboard was left as it was. See the log, then reload Echo Experience.

setup_failed_stop_route.title: Voice stop route unavailable
setup_failed_stop_route.description: Registering the fast voice stop phrases failed: {error}. “Stop” will fall through to the conversation agent until this is fixed. See the log, then reload Echo Experience.
